data-player-guid=\"2ddb2d9a-11b1-28cd-ecb8-691cb8f9faa1\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/player/_/id/209581/mikel-merino\">Mikel Merino</a> boosted their faint hopes of catching up with runaway leaders <a data-clubhouse-guid=\"a47fbcec-c948-cf4c-9e41-3dfa37588c9c\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/team?id=364\">Liverpool</a>.</p>\n<p>Merino scored in the 20th minute when he stooped to flick his looping header over <a data-player-guid=\"0e0f3d6b-8e88-dc88-650c-b4592e9cc766\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/player/_/id/108662/robert-sanchez\">Robert Sánchez</a> in the Chelsea goal after a <a data-player-guid=\"b0aef523-0156-389c-809c-1048d4660717\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/player/_/id/203669/martin-ødegaard\">Martin Ødegaard</a> corner.</p>\n<p>The midfielder, who has led Arsenal's attack in the absence of injured colleagues in recent weeks, came close to a second goal in the 60th minute but his side-footed volley was kept out by a fine save by Sanchez.</p>\n<p><photo caption=\"Mikel Merino scored the decisive goal for Arsenal.\"></p>\n<p>Chelsea were also missing firepower up front with top scorer <a data-player-guid=\"6db4c779-7f2c-07f7-14ce-64d74f7d7fad\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/player/_/id/296395/cole-palmer\">Cole Palmer</a> absent while centre forward <a data-player-guid=\"ed90b32c-f09c-302e-af63-852a1e2a9352\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/player/_/id/308524/nicolas-jackson\">Nicolas Jackson</a> remains sidelined, also due to injury.</p>\n<p>Without them, Chelsea struggled to threaten Arsenal's backline. The closest they came to an equaliser was in the 37th minute when defender <a data-player-guid=\"55ff994c-d0ad-d6f8-cbb0-922ad9b25382\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/player/_/id/259910/marc-cucurella\">Marc Cucurella</a> hammered an angled volley at <a data-player-guid=\"917afc98-2d15-9b9d-6d92-1d4ca9c6f1ae\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/player/_/id/196176/david-raya\">David Raya</a> only for the ball to squeeze through the Arsenal goalkeeper's hands and go just wide.</p>\n<p>The win left second-placed Arsenal 12 points behind Liverpool who face <a data-clubhouse-guid=\"ec6b4352-98d3-424d-6214-778d79b47a01\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/team?id=361\">Newcastle United</a> in the League Cup final later on Sunday.</p>\n<p>Both the top two teams have played 29 games with a further nine rounds of fixtures to go.</p>\n<p>Chelsea are fourth, one point ahead of <a data-clubhouse-guid=\"94fd5d7e-35b1-9d52-c9f2-4a37259bea36\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/team?id=382\">Manchester City</a> and five behind third-placed <a data-clubhouse-guid=\"ad9ef79b-ca27-077e-8a6f-335e0d220b27\" href=\"http://espn.com/soccer/team?id=393\">Nottingham
